svg.title: Knowledge Foundation Architecture
svg.desc: Many sources across many repositories — code, documentation, institutional records, defects, work items and schemas — are read by one front-end each, collapsed into a single closed vocabulary of entity and relation kinds, related by enrichment passes, and settled into a content-addressed store tied to a commit. A query layer answers questions over it, and the same facts project out as committed knowledge, dashboards, interchange exports, grounded agent inputs and cross-project patterns. Every fact carries its origin; model-inferred relations are a separate, opt-in class.
